headline: Aegidron best miner
title: Aegidron | Best Miner and Alpha Boss | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want the best miner in Palworld one point zero? Aegidron. This Dragon and Ground Pal has Mining suitability level eight, higher than older favorites like Astegon. You will find its level seventy nine alpha in the World Tree region. Even better, its partner skill makes you immune to stun and cuts explosive damage by sixty percent. Bring Ice or Grass Pals. Will you hunt it? Comment below!
description: Aegidron in Palworld 1.0 has Mining level eight, a level seventy nine World Tree alpha, and a stun immunity partner skill.
